Description: Unique identifier for each employee in the organization
The first name of the employee
The last name of the employee
The date when the employee started working for the organization
The date when the employee left or exited the organization (if applicable)
The job title or position of the employee within the organization
The name of the employee's immediate supervisor or manager
The email address associated with the employee's communication within the organization
The specific business unit or department to which the employee belongs
The current employment status of the employee
The type of employment the employee has
The pay zone or salary band to which the employee's compensation falls
The classification type of the employee
The type of termination if the employee has left the organization
Additional details or reasons for the employee's termination (if applicable)
The broader category or type of department the employee's work is associated with
The division or branch of the organization where the employee works
The date of birth of the employee
The abbreviation of a US state where the employee is located
A brief description of the employee's primary job function or role
A code representing the gender of the employee
A code representing the physical location or office where the employee is based
A description of the employee's racial or ethnic background (if provided)
The marital status of the employee
A score indicating the employee's performance level
The current rating or evaluation of the employee's overall performance
